info.title: API.SH: Betfair
info.description: The Betfair API from API.SH: public Betfair data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Betfair Exchange competitions of a sport
get.description:
Every competition of a sport with open exchange markets: id (use it as `competition` in `/betfair/v1/markets`), name, region and number of open markets.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/betfair-competitions

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Upcoming and in-play events of a sport on the Betfair Exchange: event id, name, start time, country, venue, competition and how many markets are open. Use the event id as `event` on /betfair/v1/markets. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/betfair-events

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport (default soccer).

parameters.name: competition
parameters.description: Competition ids (comma-separated) from /betfair/v1/competitions.

parameters.name: in_play
parameters.description: true: only in-play events; false: only not started.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Event country codes, comma-separated (GB,IE...).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per page (max 200).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One exchange market (or up to 10) in full: description, status, money matched and available, number of winners, bet delay, commission, the event and every runner's best three back and lay prices with available money, last traded price and runner details. Pass `id` from `/betfair/v1/markets`, or `sport` alone for that sport's most traded open market. Each runner also has `adjustment_factor` and `sp` (Betfair Starting Price near, far and actual, when published).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/betfair-market

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Market id such as 1.234567890; up to 10 comma-separated.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Without id: the most traded open market of this sport.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Betfair Exchange markets with back and lay prices
get.description:
Exchange markets of a sport (optionally one competition or event), soonest or most traded first: market name and type, start time, status, in-play flag, money matched and available, bet delay, commission, the event (name, country, start) and competition, and each runner's best three back and lay prices with the money available at each, last traded price and status (horse and greyhound racing also carry the runner's form, jockey/trainer, cloth number and silks description). Prices are in GBP and slightly delayed, as on the public exchange pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Cached 30 seconds. Also filter by the event's country and a start-time window. Each runner also has `adjustment_factor` and `sp` (Betfair Starting Price near, far and actual, when published).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/betfair-markets

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport.

parameters.name: competition
parameters.description: Competition id(s) from `/betfair/v1/competitions`, comma-separated (e.g. 10932509 for the English Premier League).

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: One event id (from `event.id`): all its markets unless market_type is given.

parameters.name: market_type
parameters.description: Market type code(s), comma-separated: MATCH_ODDS (default for team sports), WIN (racing, golf), PLACE, OVER_UNDER_25, CORRECT_SCORE, BOTH_TEAMS_TO_SCORE, HALF_TIME, ASIAN_HANDICAP ... or all.

parameters.name: in_play
parameters.description: true: only markets in play; false: only markets not yet started.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: time: soonest first; matched: most money matched first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Markets per page (1-40, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Event country code(s), comma-separated, e.g. GB,IE.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only markets starting at or after this time (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only markets starting before this time (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
